summary: Built all ten Approach steps; unit, typecheck, lint and gate pass. But plates opening at the act (step 5) break an existing e2e, solar-dense 'a captain's turn ... (22 B9)': a parked captain stands over its work's plate in 16% of samples (limit 5%). It passes on the start commit, so it is caused by this change. The fix is outside the packet (parking), so I stopped.
blocked_reason: A sortie chooses its parking spot with clearOfPlate (commands.ts:197), which needs the work's plate rect (labels.rectOf) when it first asks. Before E2 the piece's plate opened 500 ms before the maneuver started, so the rect was known during the flight and the captain parked clear of it (22 B9, PARK_TURNS). With plates opening at the act (R11), the ship has already arrived and parked at the first choice when the plate appears, so it sits over the plate. Needs a decision: (a) predict the plate's rect before it shows (labels.rectOf returns null for a hidden plate), (b) let a parked ship re-pick once the plate appears (it would move while named; the same test caps that at 12 px), or (c) relax the 5% bound. Each is a parking or label-layer change the packet doesn't list.
